name: TrendOS_BACKEND_UNIFIED_V147_CANDIDATE
purpose: Define the exact safe composition contract for the final clean Apps Script backend candidate before any live install or deploy.

productionBaseline.integrityState: Master+HEALTH ON; all business families OFF

requiredBeforeCompose: Exact persisted Apps Script Head baseline must be captured or exact-verified against an approved source lineage.
Do not assume GitHub Code.gs alone is identical to current persisted Apps Script Head.
Do not use the Sheet tab سكريبت Apps Script as authoritative deployment source.
Preserve Version 146 rollback evidence before any future Head install.
compositionGate.reason: The current tooling can prepare GitHub artifacts but cannot directly read the bound Apps Script editor project; composing a replacement backend without exact Head lineage would violate the no-blind-overwrite safety rule.

requiredNativeChanges: Bounded getRows_ reads with safe limits and view-first behavior where valid.
Short-lived getDashboard_ cache/bounded reads without source mutation.
Fast updateLine_ path using lineId-first real source-row resolution and essential-field writes only.
Legacy fallback remains active when Integrity family flags are OFF.
requiredTests: Apps Script composition syntax and duplicate-top-level collision checks.
updateLine_ fast-save and lineId-first lookup behavior.
All business Integrity family flags default OFF.
Router legacy fallback with flags OFF.
Registry writer excluded from permanent candidate.
Fast Auth V2.5 excluded from first candidate.
Cloudflare production read/write cutover remains disabled.
nextSafeAction: Capture/exact-verify the persisted Apps Script Head baseline, then compose the candidate from that verified lineage plus this manifest and run GitHub-only static tests before any Apps Script installation.
